description: This source file defines the 'GatewayNodeSession' actor which manages WebSocket connections, handles server events, including node invocation requests, and manages URL configurations and connection states for a gateway component in an OpenClaw-based application.

classes.name: GatewayNodeSession
classes.description: An actor managing WebSocket sessions, message handling, and communication with gateway nodes, including URL canonicalization, request invocation with timeout, and event handling.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeout
methods.description: Executes a bridge invoke request with a specified timeout, ensuring proper handling of timeouts and completion.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to a specified URL with the provided tokens and options, handling reconnections and initial snapshot waiting.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Shuts down the current session and resets internal connection state.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability
methods.description: Requests the current node's canvas capability and updates the local URL string accordingly.
